attributes.description: Normalized redacted evidence, treated as text; never HTML

detection_result.description: As of the list detection snapshot: pending means not processed; no_match means processed without evidence membership, not benign; evidence means an actual detection evidence member, including copied historical proof

ingestion_seq.description: Lossless PostgreSQL bigint encoded as a decimal string

post.description: Requires exact configured Origin and Host, CSRF cookie and X-CSRF-Token. Rotates session and CSRF tokens. The JSON body is limited to 8 KiB to accommodate escaped passwords up to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.
post.summary: Sign in the locally provisioned administrator
